release_notes: Mandatory OPS 4.5.22 client-only Task save correction. Task fields no longer save after every input, selection, click, focus change, realtime event or foreground event. Data is saved only by Save Progress, Complete Task, or one protective save when closing a dirty Task or sending the app to the background. No saving/saved overlay is shown. Worker v21, D1 schema, D1 data, TaskPhoto storage, assignments and historical records are unchanged.
